name: Do custom baseboards add value to my home?

mainEntity.name: Do custom baseboards add value to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom baseboards can significantly enhance your home's aesthetic appeal and perceived value. They contribute to a more finished, high-end look by adding architectural detail that standard trim often lacks. High-quality custom millwork can be a subtle yet impactful upgrade that potential buyers notice, contributing positively to your home's overall marketability, particularly in competitive markets like Meridian and Eagle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom baseboards enhance aesthetic appeal and perceived value, adding architectural detail that contributes to a high-end look and marketability.
